    <bpmn:laneSet id="audit-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="coordinator" name="Audit coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send_notification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_closed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="regional" name="Regional office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>split_prep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>prepare_statements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gather_documents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join_prep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit_documents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>provide_clarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="compliance" name="Compliance team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check_regulatory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="central" name="Central audit team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge_review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review_submission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_discrepancies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>request_clarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>risk_split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>evaluate_financial_risks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>evaluate_operational_risks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>evaluate_compliance_risks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>risk_join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_high_risk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>launch_investigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>analyse_data</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>conduct_interviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_site_visits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>visit_sites</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge_risks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>compile_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>update_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>resubmit_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>distribute_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>archive_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="director" name="Audit director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review_report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Audit process initiated" />
    <bpmn:task id="send_notification" name="Send notification to the regional office" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split_prep" name="Split preparation" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepare_statements" name="Prepare financial statements" />
    <bpmn:task id="gather_documents" name="Gather necessary documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="check_regulatory" name="Check regulatory updates" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join_prep" name="Join preparation" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit_documents" name="Submit documents to the central audit team" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge_review" name="Submission received" />
    <bpmn:task id="review_submission" name="Review the submission" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found?" />
    <bpmn:task id="request_clarifications" name="Request clarifications" />
    <bpmn:task id="provide_clarifications" name="Provide clarifications" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="risk_split" name="Split risk assessment" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluate_financial_risks" name="Evaluate financial risks" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluate_operational_risks" name="Evaluate operational risks" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluate_compliance_risks" name="Evaluate compliance risks" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="risk_join" name="Join risk assessment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_high_risk" name="High risk identified?" />
    <bpmn:task id="launch_investigation" name="Launch detailed investigation" />
    <bpmn:task id="analyse_data" name="Analyse data" />
    <bpmn:task id="conduct_interviews" name="Conduct interviews" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_site_visits" name="Site visits required?" />
    <bpmn:task id="visit_sites" name="Visit sites" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge_risks" name="All risks addressed" />
    <bpmn:task id="compile_report" name="Compile the audit report" />
    <bpmn:task id="review_report" name="Review the audit report" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_approval" name="Report approved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="update_report" name="Update the report" />
    <bpmn:task id="resubmit_report" name="Resubmit the report for review" />
    <bpmn:task id="distribute_report" name="Distribute the final report to the executive board" />
    <bpmn:task id="archive_report" name="Archive the final report" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_closed" name="Audit process closed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f01" sourceRef="start" targetRef="send_notification" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="merge_review" targetRef="review_submission" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="review_submission" targetRef="gw_discrepancies" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" name="discrepancies found" sourceRef="gw_discrepancies" targetRef="request_clarifications" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="request_clarifications" targetRef="provide_clarifications" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="provide_clarifications" targetRef="merge_review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" name="no discrepancies" sourceRef="gw_discrepancies" targetRef="risk_split" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="risk_split" targetRef="evaluate_compliance_risks" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f20" sourceRef="evaluate_financial_risks" targetRef="risk_join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f21" sourceRef="evaluate_operational_risks" targetRef="risk_join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f22" sourceRef="evaluate_compliance_risks" targetRef="risk_join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f23" sourceRef="risk_join" targetRef="gw_high_risk" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f24" name="yes" sourceRef="gw_high_risk" targetRef="launch_investigation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f25" name="no" sourceRef="gw_high_risk" targetRef="merge_risks" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f34" sourceRef="review_report" targetRef="gw_approval" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f35" name="approved" sourceRef="gw_approval" targetRef="distribute_report" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f36" name="revisions required" sourceRef="gw_approval" targetRef="update_report" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f37" sourceRef="update_report" targetRef="resubmit_report" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f39" sourceRef="distribute_report" targetRef="archive_report" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f40" sourceRef="archive_report" targetRef="end_closed" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
